label: Diagram 1.3
caption: Diagram 1.3 | WC access zones
description:
This diagram, titled 'Diagram 1.3 WC access zones', consists of two plan-view examples labelled 'Example 1.3A'. 

The left side, 'Example 1.3A – Clear access for oblique transfer', shows a toilet with a circular symbol in the centre. A rectangular shaded area, representing an access zone, sits in front of the toilet. This zone is 750mm deep and 750mm wide. The width is split by a dimension line into 450mm and 400mm. An 'Opening to front of WC' is marked as 250mm.

The right side, 'Example 1.3A – Clear access for frontal transfer', also shows a toilet and a rectangular shaded access zone. This zone is 750mm deep and is split into two equal widths of 450mm* and 450mm*. 

Three notes are provided: 1. All dimensions minimum unless otherwise stated. 2. * denotes minimum but 500mm preferred. 3. Basins should not project into access zones in such a way as to impede access.
